outputContract: Vega-Lite blocks must be strict RFC 8259 JSON (a pure Vega-Lite spec object)
Do not output comments, trailing commas, undefined, NaN, Infinity, or functions
All keys must use double quotes; all string values must use double quotes
The top-level object IS the Vega-Lite spec -- do not wrap it in extra nesting
Always include inline data via "data": {"values": [...]} -- do not use external URLs
Include realistic, descriptive data values -- not placeholder numbers
CRITICAL: ALL numeric values in data must be actual JSON numbers, NOT strings. WRONG: "value": "1.1%". CORRECT: "value": 1.1
Use encoding channels (x, y, color, size, etc.) with field, type, and optionally aggregate
Do not set the $schema field -- the renderer adds it automatically
Do not set color/backgroundColor/textStyle.color -- the renderer applies theme-aware styles automatically for both light and dark modes

chartTypes.name: Box Plot / 箱线图
chartTypes.description: Statistical distribution summary: median, quartiles, outliers across categories.
chartTypes.notes: Provide raw data points -- Vega-Lite computes quartiles automatically. Mark type "boxplot" is a composite mark.

chartTypes.name: Multi-Layer Composition / 多层组合
chartTypes.description: Overlay multiple marks (line+point, bar+text, area+rule) in a single chart.
chartTypes.notes: Place shared data at the top level. Each layer object has its own mark and encoding. Use rule mark for reference lines.

chartTypes.name: Small Multiples / Facet / 分面图
chartTypes.description: Split one chart into a grid of sub-charts by a categorical variable for comparison.
chartTypes.notes: Use encoding.facet to split by a field. Set columns to control grid layout. Can also use row/column encoding for 2D grids.
